1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — returns n constrained to [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats bytes as human-readable (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`loadSettings(filePath)`** in src/settings.js — reads and parses JSON with defaults, throws uppercase error codes (FILE_NOT_FOUND, FILE_READ_ERROR, INVALID_JSON) for errors

All error messages follow the project convention of starting with an uppercase snake-case error code followed by a colon.
